responsibility: This header declares GCC’s sparse bitmap abstraction and its public API. It defines the bitmap and bitmap_element data representation, iterator macros and helper classes such as auto_bitmap and bitmap_view, and exposes the operations and traversal interfaces used by optimization and analysis passes to build, query, and combine sparse integer sets while remaining independent of a particular allocation strategy.
same_name_distinction: Declares the bitmap representation and public traversal/API surface—bitmap_head, bitmap_element layout, iterator macros, auto_bitmap, and bitmap_view—while gcc/bitmap.cc contains the executable algorithms, memory-management machinery, statistics support, and selftests behind that interface.
